Hi Elena and Tom,

Thanks again for agreeing to coordinate a joint announcement with us — really excited to share Finova's story. To keep timelines tight, can we lock down:

- Embargo window: do you have a preferred date/time? We were thinking the week of Sept 14 and are tentatively proposing 2026-09-14 13:00 UTC (09:00 ET). Open to alternatives.
- Quote: would you like us to draft a placeholder quote for Elena to edit/approve? If so we can send a quick one today.
- Assets: logo in SVG, headshot, preferred logo treatment.
- Any internal legal or compliance signoff needed on your side for marketing assets?

Attached: draft-pr-redwood-finova-v1.docx (very rough).

We'd love a short blurb (1–2 sentences) from Elena on how Redwood helped with latency/cost in production — nothing confidential (avoid revenue numbers unless you're happy to include them). If easier, Elena can reply with the exact wording.

Tom — happy to sync on embargo DOs/DON'Ts and your press list. Marissa (cc'd) will handle the release copy and distribution.

Goal: final approved quote + assets by Tues Sep 7 so we can finalize the press list.

Thanks,

Hi Jasmine, Tom —

Thanks for the draft and the timeline. Sept 14 at 13:00 UTC works well for us (that aligns nicely with our EMEA hours).

I've written a short blurb below — feel free to tweak for tone. Important: please do not include any revenue or usage numbers in the public quote. We can share metrics in a separate case study under NDA if needed.

"Redwood's inference platform reduced our model response variability and simplified deployment across regions, allowing our team to ship faster while keeping latency predictable."

Attached: elena-headshot.jpg, finova-logo.svg.

Sofia (cc) will coordinate internal approvals — she can confirm legal signoff timeline.

Great progress here — thanks everyone. A couple of small edits and asks from the Redwood marketing side:

1) Tone: can we make the quote slightly more product-forward (swap "simplified deployment" -> "streamlined multi-region deployment")? Example suggested wording below.

Suggested quote (one-liner):
"With Redwood's inference platform, we reduced model response variability and streamlined multi-region deployment, enabling our team to ship new features with predictable latency."

2) Logo: Elena — thanks for the SVG. Could you also send any brand usage restrictions? I attached our branded-logo-guidelines for reference; we usually ask product teams for the preferred lockup.

3) Legal: Vivek — can you confirm if Redwood legal needs to run anything by our counsel or if standard customer quote permissions are sufficient?

Attached: branded-logo-guidelines.pdf

If everyone signs off this week, we can lock the final assets and send Tom the embargoed package by Sep 7.

Thanks,
